attributes.name: Alrys Harnaste
attributes.powers:
Alrys Harnaste is immune to the Mental and Poison traits. If the check to defeat does not have the Magic trait, Alrys Harnaste is undefeated.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from; if you succeed, display this card next to your deck. While displayed, the difficulty of your checks is increased by 2. At the start of your turn, 1 character at your location may succeed at a Divine 9 check to banish this card.

corrections.corrected_text: On the henchman Alrys Harnaste, change "if you do, display this card next to your deck" to "if you succeed, display this card next to your deck".
corrections.issue: Do you display Alrys Harnaste if you fail to close the location he came from, or only if you succeed?
